abilities.name: Swing Dance Etiquette
abilities.text: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 1% of the Trailblazer's ATK to a single target enemy.

abilities.name: Halftime to Make It Rain
abilities.text: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 0.5% of the Trailblazer's ATK to a single target enemy and additionally deals DMG for 4 times, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to 0.5% of the Trailblazer's ATK to a random enemy.

abilities.name: All-Out Footlight Parade
abilities.text: Grants all allies the Backup Dancer effect, lasting for 3 turn(s). This duration reduces by 1 at the start of Trailblazer's every turn. Allies that have the Backup Dancer effect have their Break Effect increased by 0.3%. And when they attack enemy targets that are in the Weakness Broken state, the Toughness Reduction of this attack will be converted into 1 instance of Super Break DMG.

abilities.name: Full-on Aerial Dance
abilities.text: The Trailblazer immediately regenerates 10 Energy when an enemy target's Weakness is Broken.

abilities.name: Now! I'm the Band!
abilities.text: After the Technique is used, at the start of the next battle, all allies' Break Effect increases by 0.3%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Dance With the One
abilities.desc: When the number of enemy targets on the field is 5 or more/4/3/2/1, the Super Break DMG triggered by the Backup Dancer effect increases by 20%/30%/40%/50%/60%.

abilities.name: Shuffle Along
abilities.desc: When using Skill, additionally increases the Toughness Reduction of the first instance of DMG by 100%.

abilities.name: Hat of the Theater
abilities.desc: Additionally delays the enemy target's action by 30% when allies Break enemy Weaknesses.

abilities.name: Best Seat in the House
abilities.desc: After using Skill for the first time, immediately recovers 1 Skill Point(s).

abilities.name: Jailbreaking Rainbowwalk
abilities.desc: When the battle starts, the Trailblazer's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by 25%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

abilities.name: Sanatorium for Rest Notes
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Dove in Tophat
abilities.desc: While the Trailblazer is on the field, increases the Break Effect of all teammates (excluding the Trailblazer), by an amount equal to 15% of the Trailblazer's Break Effect.

abilities.name: Poem Favors Rhythms of Old
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: Tomorrow, Rest in Spotlight
abilities.desc: The number of additional DMG applications by the Skill increases by 2.
